description: Unique ID for one onboarding task (one row = one task)
notes: The raw export can contain exact duplicate rows; the cleaned file has one row per request

description: Fictional new-hire ID shared by all of that employee's requests
notes: Used to split train/validation/test by employee

description: Type of onboarding task
notes: Every employee gets payroll_setup and system_access; others depend on role. Recorded values may contain recording problems (case or spelling variants, extra spaces); the official cleaned file maps them to the allowed values

description: Team assigned by the routing rule from task_type
notes: Derived by rule; coordinator confirms. Recorded values may contain recording problems (case or spelling variants, extra spaces); the official cleaned file maps them to the allowed values

description: Hiring department as written on the request
allowed_values: Parks; Transit; Recreation; Finance; Utilities; Administration; blank
notes: Blank = missing at intake; used for missing-data analysis. Recorded values may contain recording problems (case or spelling variants, extra spaces); the official cleaned file maps them to the allowed values

description: Hiring department confirmed by the coordinator once the information check is complete
allowed_values: Parks; Transit; Recreation; Finance; Utilities; Administration; blank
notes: Blank until the information check is complete; can also be blank because of a recording problem, in which case cleaning fills it only when the information check is complete and the employee's other rows agree on one value. Recorded values may contain recording problems (case or spelling variants, extra spaces); the official cleaned file maps them to the allowed values

description: Job category of the new hire (not a personal attribute)
notes: Same value on all of one employee's requests; can be blank because of a recording problem (cleaning fills it when the employee's other rows agree). Recorded values may contain recording problems (case or spelling variants, extra spaces); the official cleaned file maps them to the allowed values

description: How the request was submitted
notes: Can be blank because of a recording problem; no trusted source exists to recover it, so it stays blank after cleaning. Recorded values may contain recording problems (case or spelling variants, extra spaces); the official cleaned file maps them to the allowed values

description: When the request arrived
notes: Can fall outside working hours, on weekends, or on closure dates (requesters submit any time). A few values are invalid dates or year typos; cleaning repairs them from the request's submitted event in status_events.csv. One fixed local clock (no time zones or daylight saving)

description: Start date as written on the request
notes: Blank = missing; may differ from the employee's reference start date (conflict rule c). A few values are impossible dates; with no trusted source, cleaning leaves them blank

description: Start date confirmed by the coordinator once the information check is complete
notes: Blank until the information check is complete; used to calculate business_days_until_start and the 08:00 deadline. Future dates can appear (employees starting after the extract)

description: Item requested for an equipment setup task, as submitted
notes: Kept as submitted for missing-data analysis; the information check resolves missing or conflicting items before checkpoint_1. not_applicable = no item needed (non-equipment task); blank on an equipment task = missing; any item on a non-equipment task = conflict (rule a; see data card). The text not_applicable is used instead of N/A because tools such as pandas read N/A as missing

description: Optional short synthetic comment from the requester
notes: Reserved; may be tested later if text features are course-appropriate

description: Was required information missing or conflicting when submitted?
Kind of information issue at intake
When all required information was complete
notes: Within working hours on a business day: equals submitted_at for a complete request submitted during working hours, the start of the next working day for one submitted after hours, or the requester's reply for a request with an issue. Blank if not complete by the extract. Checkpoint 1 happens here

description: When the task was assigned to the responsible team
notes: Blank if not assigned by the extract; matches the corresponding event in status_events.csv

description: When the responsible team finished the setup
notes: Blank if the team had not finished by the extract (a genuinely unfinished task; never a recording problem). Used for the deadline (ready if at or before 08:00 on confirmed_start_date)

description: When the coordinator confirmed completion
notes: Blank if not confirmed by the extract; status becomes complete

description: Status after the request's latest event recorded by the extract
notes: Same rule as status_events.csv; a team-finished task awaiting coordinator confirmation stays in_progress with team_completed_at filled

description: Was team_completed_at at or before 08:00 on confirmed_start_date, as known at the extract?
notes: True/False when completed; False when unfinished and the deadline has passed; blank (unknown) when unfinished and the deadline is after the extract or the start date is not yet confirmed. Unknown values are never filled. Not a model input

description: Unique ID for one status event
Task the event belongs to
What happened
allowed_values: submitted; info_requested; info_received; assigned_to_team; team_completed; completion_confirmed
notes: No follow-up events: the simulation has no intervention

description: Request status after the event
notes: submitted -> open; info_requested -> waiting_for_information; info_received -> open; assigned_to_team -> in_progress; team_completed -> in_progress (stays until confirmed); completion_confirmed -> complete

description: When the event happened
notes: Only events up to the extract. Accurate by construction (no recording problems), so a trusted source for documented repairs. Coordinator and team events fall on business days within working hours

description: Who performed the event
Unique ID for one risk assessment
Task being assessed
notes: Static model inputs are joined from requests.csv

description: Employee the task belongs to
notes: Split key

description: Which assessment
notes: checkpoint_1 = when information is complete; checkpoint_2 = 08:00 on the weekday five business days before confirmed_start_date, only if after checkpoint_1 and the task is not yet completed by the team

description: When the assessment happened
notes: Only assessments up to the extract

description: Business-day count until the start date, including the assessment date; not full working days remaining
allowed_values: Integer; 0 or negative when assessed on or after the start date
notes: Business days (Monday-Friday, excluding the simulated closure dates) from the assessment day up to the day before confirmed_start_date, counting the assessment day; negative after the start date (on the start date = 0). Always 5 at checkpoint_2

description: Status at assessment time
notes: checkpoint_1 always happens before assignment, so its status is always open; waiting_for_information cannot occur because assessments happen after information is complete

description: Business days the task has been in its current status
notes: Business days from the day the current status began up to the day before the assessment day (the assessment day is not counted)

description: Other tasks for the same team assigned strictly before the assessment time and completing strictly after it
notes: Tasks assigned or completed at the same timestamp are excluded; the same rule as the simulation's workload delay; no future information

description: Was the assessment at or after 08:00 on confirmed_start_date (task already overdue)?
notes: Not a model input. When True, at_risk is always True; report evaluation for all assessments and for early-warning assessments only (False)

description: Would the task miss the deadline (after 08:00 on confirmed_start_date) without intervention?
notes: Blank when the task's outcome is unknown at the extract (not eligible for modelling). Same for both checkpoints of one task; from the no-intervention simulation; always True when past_deadline_at_assessment is True and the outcome is known

description: Unique ID for one recording problem
notes: Evaluation only: never used to clean, fill, or model the analysis data

description: Row of the affected record in data/requests.csv (header = row 1)
notes: For auditing the raw export; evaluate field problems by request_id and field after removing duplicates

description: Request containing the problem
Kind of recording problem
allowed_values: category_variant; extra_whitespace; missing_value; exact_duplicate; impossible_date; year_typo

description: Field containing the problem (blank for exact_duplicate)
allowed_values: Any requests.csv field name or blank
notes: A duplicate copy inherits any problem in its original; the key logs those against the original row only

description: Value as it appears in the export
Value before the recording problem
notes: Used only to evaluate cleaning afterwards

description: Task the simulation values belong to
Normal business days the team needs for this task
notes: Evaluation only; never a model input

description: Extra unexplained processing days
notes: Rounded exponential draw with an underlying mean of 2, applied with probability 0.25

description: Extra business days when a task got stuck
notes: 2% of tasks

description: Extra business days because the team had more open tasks than its capacity at assignment
notes: Capacity evaluated once at assignment, including summer and short-staffed periods

description: Extra business days of delay not known at assessment time
Label for the hidden delay
notes: Randomly assigned label

description: Full simulated team completion time, including times after the extract
notes: Must never be used to fill unknown outcomes or blank completions in the analysis data

description: Full simulated readiness, including outcomes unknown at the extract
notes: Evaluation only

description: Official cleaned requests: exact duplicates removed, categories mapped to allowed values, employee-level blanks filled when the employee's other rows agree (a confirmed department only once the information check is complete), invalid submission times repaired from status events, impossible submitted start dates blanked
notes: Made by cleaning/make_cleaned.py (cleaning version 1.1); unresolved values stay blank; how it was made is in requests_cleaned_info.json
